# FORMIKA

> FORMIKA is a Latvia-based studio creating personalized LEGO-style gifts and decorative compositions from customer photos and ideas.

The website is available in Russian, Latvian, and English. Visitors can view examples of completed work, explore available products, and submit an order request.

## Main pages

- [FORMIKA home page](/): Main information about the studio, products, examples, and ordering process.
- [Create an order](/order): Submit an order request for a personalized product.
- [Our work](/#works): Examples of personalized frames, couple compositions, family compositions, and wedding compositions.
- [Our advantages](/#advantages): Information about the production and ordering process.
- [FORMIKA on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/f0rmika.studio/): Portfolio, new work, and studio updates.

## Products and services

FORMIKA creates:

- Personalized LEGO-style frames
- Compositions for couples
- Family compositions
- Wedding compositions
- LED lighting decorations
- Ready-made keychains
- Personalized keychains

## Languages

The website content is available in:

- Russian
- Latvian
- English

## Contact

For orders and questions, use the order page or contact FORMIKA through Instagram.

## Important information

Product appearance, price, production time, and delivery details may depend on the selected design and order requirements. Confirm current details when placing an order.
